ModMetaData.name: Storage Overview
ModMetaData.author: ifchen0
ModMetaData.description:
Warning: this mod was written with AI coding tools (Claude Code).
Adds an Overview tab next to the Storage tab of every stockpile and storage building. It opens a table of the storage filters of every stockpile, storage group and storage building on the map, side by side.
The item tree on the left is the same one the vanilla storage tab uses. Each storage is a column of the usual checkboxes, so one row shows at a glance where an item may be stored, and an item missing from a storage that holds everything similar stands out. Opening a category opens it for every column at once. Items a storage can never hold leave its cell empty.
Ticking a box changes that storage's filter exactly like the vanilla storage tab does, including click-and-drag painting.
Safe to add to or remove from an existing save.
